info.name: Zayo APIs Maintenance Cases Ticket Catalog API

items.docs: Get the Zayo trouble ticket catalog where tickets are represented as a `ticketType`. For each `ticketType` get the description and latest version.

params.name: ticketType
params.description: Ticket type returned from the get ticket catalog route.

params.name: version
params.description: Semantic version returned from the get ticket catalog route.

items.docs: After you get the latest semantic version from the ticket-catalog route, plug this into the ticket-type-details route to dynamically receive the latest request schema with required and optional attributes needed per ticket type/version combination.
